grammar.pattern: 动宾式离合词：对象、数量和时长
grammar.purpose: Place added material inside the separable construction
grammar.explanation: 帮忙 can expand to 帮我一个忙, 见面 to 跟朋友见一次面, 理发 to 理个发, 睡觉 to 睡了一个小时的觉. Do not attach every object after the full compound: 帮忙我 is not the intended standard request. With 结婚 use 跟/和…结婚 rather than 结婚她. The semantic object is built into the compound; duration/number placement depends on the construction, and not every two-character verb is separable.

examples.en: Could you do me a favour?

examples.en: I would like to meet her once.

examples.py: tā qù lǐ gè fā , xià wǔ zài lián xì .

commonMistakes.why: Place the beneficiary and quantity inside this separable verb.

grammar.pattern: 连动句：同一主语的连续动作或目的
grammar.purpose: Keep the actor and purpose clear in a request
grammar.explanation: 我去办公室复印两页 states my going and copying, with copying as the trip purpose. 她来找我讨论时间 shares one actor across linked verbs. A different actor must be stated separately. 去问时间 describes an intended task, not proof an answer was obtained; ask for the result afterward.

examples.py: wǒ qù bàn gōng shì fù yìn liǎng yè .
examples.en: I go to the office to photocopy two pages.

examples.py: tā lái zhǎo wǒ tǎo lùn shí jiān .
examples.en: She comes to find me to discuss the time.

examples.zh: 我联系她问时间，还没收到回答。

examples.en: I contact her to ask the time and have not received an answer.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我去办公室你复印两页。这里说我做两件事。
commonMistakes.why: Keep the shared actor for the intended linked actions.

lines.zh: 麻烦你帮我一个忙，问问小周周六几点能到。
lines.py: má fán nǐ bāng wǒ yī gè máng , wèn wèn xiǎo zhōu zhōu liù jǐ diǎn néng dào .
lines.en: Could you do me a favour and ask when Xiao Zhou can arrive on Saturday?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行，我下午联系她。她现在去理发了。
lines.py: xíng , wǒ xià wǔ lián xì tā . tā xiàn zài qù lǐ fà le .
lines.en: Sure. I'll contact her this afternoon. She's getting a haircut now.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我想约她一起去书店，三点还是四点都可以。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng yuē tā yì qǐ qù shū diàn , sān diǎn hái shi sì diǎn dōu kě yǐ .
lines.en: I'd like to go to the bookshop with her. Three or four would work.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那我把两个时间都问一下。
lines.py: nà wǒ bǎ liǎng gè shí jiān dōu wèn yī xià .
lines.en: I'll ask about both times.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好。我先去办公室复印两页，回来再看消息。
lines.py: hǎo . wǒ xiān qù bàn gōng shì fù yìn liǎng yè , huí lái zài kàn xiāo xī .
lines.en: Good. I'll photocopy two pages at the office and check the messages when I return.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你去办公室？能帮我也复印这一页吗？
lines.py: nǐ qù bàn gōng shì ? néng bāng wǒ yě fù yìn zhè yī yè ma ?
lines.en: You're going to the office? Could you copy this page for me too?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 能，拿给我吧。
lines.py: néng , ná gěi wǒ ba .
lines.en: Yes. Hand it to me.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 谢谢。书店还有一位朋友要来，我也问问她。
lines.py: xiè xiè . shū diàn hái yǒu yī wèi péng you yào lái , wǒ yě wèn wèn tā .
lines.en: Thanks. Another friend wants to come to the bookshop; I'll ask her too.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我们到了先互相介绍一下。
lines.py: nà wǒ men dào le xiān hù xiāng jiè shào yī xià .
lines.en: We can introduce ourselves when we get there.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，别一下问太多，让我先等小周回消息。
lines.py: hǎo , bié yī xià wèn tài duō , ràng wǒ xiān děng xiǎo zhōu huí xiāo xī .
lines.en: Sure. Don't ask me everything at once; let me wait for Xiao Zhou's reply first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行，你不是一边理发一边回消息吧？
lines.py: xíng , nǐ bù shì yī biān lǐ fà yī biān huí xiāo xī ba ?
lines.en: Okay. You're not replying while getting a haircut too, are you?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 没有，我还在这里听你说呢。
lines.py: méi yǒu , wǒ hái zài zhè lǐ tīng nǐ shuō ne .
lines.en: No. I'm still here listening to you.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: A bounded favour
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 我想周六约小周去书店，三点和四点都可以。陈宇说她去理发了，下午再联系。我就先去办公室复印两页材料。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng zhōu liù yuē xiǎo zhōu qù shū diàn , sān diǎn hé sì diǎn dōu kě yǐ . chén yǔ shuō tā qù lǐ fà le , xià wǔ zài lián xì . wǒ jiù xiān qù bàn gōng shì fù yìn liǎng yè cái liào .
lines.en: I wanted to go to the bookshop with Xiao Zhou on Saturday; three or four would work. Chen Yu said she was getting a haircut and would contact her that afternoon. I went to the office to photocopy two pages first.

lines.zh: 出门以前，陈宇把自己的一页交给我，麻烦我一起复印。办公室没有排队，我很快就印好了三页，放进包里。
lines.py: chū mén yǐ qián , chén yǔ bǎ zì jǐ de yī yè jiāo gěi wǒ , má fán wǒ yì qǐ fù yìn . bàn gōng shì méi yǒu pái duì , wǒ hěn kuài jiù yìn hǎo le sān yè , fàng jìn bāo lǐ .
lines.en: Before I left, Chen Yu handed me a page and asked me to copy it too. There was no queue at the office. I quickly copied all three pages and put them in my bag.

lines.zh: 回来的路上，我看手机，小周还没回答。陈宇说不用急，她理完发还要坐车回家，可能到家以后才看消息。
lines.py: huí lái de lù shàng , wǒ kàn shǒu jī , xiǎo zhōu hái méi huí dá . chén yǔ shuō bù yòng jí , tā lǐ wán fā hái yào zuò chē huí jiā , kě néng dào jiā yǐ hòu cái kàn xiāo xī .
lines.en: On the way back I checked my phone. Xiao Zhou hadn't replied yet. Chen Yu said not to rush; she had a bus ride home after her haircut and might only check messages there.

lines.zh: 下午两点，她说三点半能到。这个时间也合适，我就在手机里写好书店的地址，发给陈宇和她。
lines.py: xià wǔ liǎng diǎn , tā shuō sān diǎn bàn néng dào . zhè gè shí jiān yě hé shì , wǒ jiù zài shǒu jī lǐ xiě hǎo shū diàn de dì zhǐ , fā gěi chén yǔ hé tā .
lines.en: At two she said she could arrive at three thirty. That worked too, so I wrote out the bookshop address on my phone and sent it to both of them.

lines.zh: 另外一位朋友四点到，我们先找了四个位子。她来了以后，陈宇介绍我们认识；聊了一会儿，才发现我们上次去过同一个活动。
lines.py: lìng wài yī wèi péng you sì diǎn dào , wǒ men xiān zhǎo le sì gè wèi zi . tā lái le yǐ hòu , chén yǔ jiè shào wǒ men rèn shi ; liáo le yī huì er , cái fā xiàn wǒ men shàng cì qù guò tóng yī gè huó dòng .
lines.en: The other friend would arrive at four, so we found four seats first. Chen Yu introduced us when she came. After chatting, we discovered we'd been to the same event before.

lines.zh: 走以前，我把复印的那一页给陈宇。他拿着纸笑了，说我们忙着等消息，他自己都忘了这件事。
lines.py: zǒu yǐ qián , wǒ bǎ fù yìn de nà yī yè gěi chén yǔ . tā ná zhe zhǐ xiào le , shuō wǒ men máng zhe děng xiāo xī , tā zì jǐ dōu wàng le zhè jiàn shì .
lines.en: Before leaving I gave Chen Yu his copied page. He smiled: we'd been so busy waiting for messages that he'd forgotten it himself.

choices: They agree on three thirty and meet another friend
questions.answer: They agree on three thirty and meet another friend

choices: He had forgotten his page while waiting for replies

lines.zh: 也是。下次先把茶喝完。
lines.py: yě shì . xià cì xiān bǎ chá hē wán .

extraReadings.title: Could you ask them for me?: words in context
extraReadings.blurb: Independent everyday examples; these are separate situations.
extraReadings.purpose: Understand each word in a different situation.

lines.zh: 我们互相介绍了一下。
lines.py: wǒ men hù xiāng jiè shào le yī xià .
lines.en: We introduced ourselves to each other.

lines.zh: 两位朋友互相帮忙搬家。
lines.py: liǎng wèi péng you hù xiāng bāng máng bān jiā .
lines.en: The two friends helped each other move home.

lines.zh: 两个小组相互交流想法。
lines.py: liǎng gè xiǎo zǔ xiāng hù jiāo liú xiǎng fǎ .
lines.en: The two groups exchanged ideas.

lines.zh: 这些问题之间有相互联系。
lines.py: zhè xiē wèn tí zhī jiān yǒu xiāng hù lián xì .
lines.en: These problems are interconnected.

lines.zh: 到了以后，请联系我。
lines.py: dào le yǐ hòu , qǐng lián xì wǒ .
lines.en: Please contact me when you arrive.

lines.zh: 我好久没和她联系了。
lines.py: wǒ hǎo jiǔ méi hé tā lián xì le .
lines.en: I haven't been in touch with her for ages.

lines.zh: 这间房有人了，我们找另外一间吧。
lines.py: zhè jiān fáng yǒu rén le , wǒ men zhǎo lìng wài yī jiān ba .
lines.en: This room is occupied. Let's find another.

lines.zh: 我要一杯茶，另外再加一块蛋糕。
lines.py: wǒ yào yī bēi chá , lìng wài zài jiā yī kuài dàn gāo .
lines.en: I'd like tea, and a slice of cake as well.

lines.zh: 这件事有点麻烦，需要多一点时间。
lines.py: zhè jiàn shì yǒu diǎn má fán , xū yào duō yī diǎn shí jiān .
lines.en: This is a little complicated and needs more time.

lines.zh: 麻烦你帮我拿一下包。
lines.py: má fán nǐ bāng wǒ ná yī xià bāo .
lines.en: Could you get my bag for me, please?

lines.zh: 我想向老师请教这个问题。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng xiàng lǎo shī qǐng jiào zhè gè wèn tí .
lines.en: I'd like to ask the teacher about this problem.

lines.zh: 她向朋友请教做这道菜的方法。
lines.py: tā xiàng péng you qǐng jiào zuò zhè dào cài de fāng fǎ .
lines.en: She asked a friend how to make this dish.

lines.zh: 我去门口打听一下开门时间。
lines.py: wǒ qù mén kǒu dǎ tīng yī xià kāi mén shí jiān .
lines.en: I'll ask at the entrance about opening hours.

lines.zh: 你帮我打听到地址了吗？
lines.py: nǐ bāng wǒ dǎ tīng dào dì zhǐ le ma ?
lines.en: Did you find out the address for me?

lines.zh: 记者明天来访问这位作家。
lines.py: jì zhě míng tiān lái fǎng wèn zhè wèi zuò jiā .
lines.en: The journalist is interviewing this writer tomorrow.

lines.zh: 我访问过那所学校。
lines.py: wǒ fǎng wèn guò nà suǒ xué xiào .
lines.en: I've visited that school.

lines.zh: 今天我负责接待来参加活动的人。
lines.py: jīn tiān wǒ fù zé jiē dài lái cān jiā huó dòng de rén .
lines.en: I'm welcoming the people coming to the event today.

lines.zh: 她接待了两位从外地来的客人。
lines.py: tā jiē dài le liǎng wèi cóng wài dì lái de kè rén .
lines.en: She hosted two visitors from out of town.

lines.zh: 你来得很及时，刚好还有一个座位。
lines.py: nǐ lái de hěn jí shí , gāng hǎo hái yǒu yī gè zuò wèi .
lines.en: You're just in time; there's one seat left.

lines.zh: 发现错误要及时改正。
lines.py: fā xiàn cuò wù yào jí shí gǎi zhèng .
lines.en: An error should be corrected promptly when found.

lines.zh: 我想提前十分钟到。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng tí qián shí fēn zhōng dào .
lines.en: I'd like to arrive ten minutes early.

lines.zh: 她提前告诉我周末没空。
lines.py: tā tí qián gào sù wǒ zhōu mò méi kōng .
lines.en: She told me in advance that she was busy at the weekend.

lines.zh: 我们约在书店门口见。
lines.py: wǒ men yuē zài shū diàn mén kǒu jiàn .
lines.en: We arranged to meet at the bookshop entrance.

lines.zh: 我想约她周六一起吃饭。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng yuē tā zhōu liù yì qǐ chī fàn .
lines.en: I'd like to invite her for a meal on Saturday.

lines.zh: 走以前，我和朋友告别。
lines.py: zǒu yǐ qián , wǒ hé péng you gào bié .
lines.en: I said goodbye to my friend before leaving.

lines.zh: 她到车站和家人告别。
lines.py: tā dào chē zhàn hé jiā rén gào bié .
lines.en: She went to the station to say goodbye to her family.

lines.zh: 我下午去理发。
lines.py: wǒ xià wǔ qù lǐ fà .
lines.en: I'm getting a haircut this afternoon.

lines.zh: 他在楼下理发，半小时后回来。
lines.py: tā zài lóu xià lǐ fà , bàn xiǎo shí hòu huí lái .
lines.en: He's getting a haircut downstairs and will be back in half an hour.

lines.zh: 他们明年准备结婚。
lines.py: tā men míng nián zhǔn bèi jié hūn .
lines.en: They plan to marry next year.

lines.zh: 她结婚以后搬到了北京。
lines.py: tā jié hūn yǐ hòu bān dào le běi jīng .
lines.en: She moved to Beijing after getting married.

lines.zh: 我们的谈话还没结束。
lines.py: wǒ men de tán huà hái méi jié shù .
lines.en: Our conversation hasn't finished.

lines.zh: 她和老师谈话以后，放心了。
lines.py: tā hé lǎo shī tán huà yǐ hòu , fàng xīn le .
lines.en: She felt reassured after speaking with the teacher.

lines.zh: 我想听听你的建议。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng tīng tīng nǐ de jiàn yì .
lines.en: I'd like your suggestions.

lines.zh: 这个建议很有用，我会试试。
lines.py: zhè gè jiàn yì hěn yǒu yòng , wǒ huì shì shì .
lines.en: This suggestion is useful; I'll try it.

lines.zh: 还有什么需要补充的吗？
lines.py: hái yǒu shén me xū yào bǔ chōng de ma ?
lines.en: Is there anything else to add?

lines.zh: 她补充了一条新的消息。
lines.py: tā bǔ chōng le yī tiáo xīn de xiāo xī .
lines.en: She added a piece of new information.

lines.zh: 请帮我复印这两页。
lines.py: qǐng bāng wǒ fù yìn zhè liǎng yè .
lines.en: Please photocopy these two pages for me.

lines.zh: 楼下有地方可以复印。
lines.py: lóu xià yǒu dì fāng kě yǐ fù yìn .
lines.en: There's somewhere downstairs where you can make photocopies.

lines.zh: 她们是亲姐妹。
lines.py: tā men shì qīn jiě mèi .
lines.en: They're biological sisters.

lines.zh: 他和我很亲，常常来找我。
lines.py: tā hé wǒ hěn qīn , cháng cháng lái zhǎo wǒ .
lines.en: He's very close to me and often comes to see me.

lines.zh: 领导明天也来参加活动。
lines.py: lǐng dǎo míng tiān yě lái cān jiā huó dòng .
lines.en: Our manager is coming to the event tomorrow too.

lines.zh: 他领导这个小组完成了任务。
lines.py: tā lǐng dǎo zhè gè xiǎo zǔ wán chéng le rèn wù .
lines.en: He led the group in completing the task.

lines.zh: 她和邻居交往很多年了。
lines.py: tā hé lín jū jiāo wǎng hěn duō nián le .
lines.en: She has known and interacted with her neighbours for years.

lines.zh: 我喜欢和性格不同的人交往。
lines.py: wǒ xǐ huān hé xìng gé bù tóng de rén jiāo wǎng .
lines.en: I like getting to know people with different personalities.

audio.zh: 好。我先去办公室复印两页，回来再看消息。
audio.py: hǎo . wǒ xiān qù bàn gōng shì fù yìn liǎng yè , huí lái zài kàn xiāo xī .
audio.en: Good. I'll photocopy two pages at the office and check the messages when I return.

tasks.statement: The narrator will copy two pages at the office.
tasks.why: The heard line states this fact.

audio.zh: 走以前，我把复印的那一页给陈宇。他拿着纸笑了，说我们忙着等消息，他自己都忘了这件事。
audio.py: zǒu yǐ qián , wǒ bǎ fù yìn de nà yī yè gěi chén yǔ . tā ná zhe zhǐ xiào le , shuō wǒ men máng zhe děng xiāo xī , tā zì jǐ dōu wàng le zhè jiàn shì .
audio.en: Before leaving I gave Chen Yu his copied page. He smiled: we'd been so busy waiting for messages that he'd forgotten it himself.

tasks.statement: Chen Yu had been thinking about his copied page the whole time.
tasks.why: The heard line states a different outcome.

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三05, 三57. Native check: separated forms 帮我一个忙/见一次面/理个发, variable duration constructions, 跟…结婚 versus direct object, shared-subject linked verbs, 亲 adjective in 亲姐妹 and informal metaphor in the original scene. Native review pending; no actual personal appointment is made. Planned retrieval 二49 / 二50 / 二57 / 三03 / 三07: 请她把杯子端出来。, 先取出面粉，再称一百克。, 谁都可以只听，不一定参加比赛。, 不敢参加，不等于没有能力。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Early HSK 3 correction: warm introductions at a reading group, a hesitant reader taking a first turn, a one-hour volunteer handover and friends helping with messages and copying. Removed relationship-inference, unlimited-consent and assessment-policy cautions from ordinary speech. All 22 target records have two independent authored contexts, including formal or bound forms outside the casual scene. Preserved all old unit/word/task IDs. Native flags: 老王 and 小李 forms of address; bound 者/员 and 志愿 application sense; 怕是 cautious prediction; colloquial 留个位子/接班 and quiet cat/chair teasing; 没收到 méi shōu dào rather than 没收 mò shōu; warmth versus familiarity in 亲切; 亲 as blood relation or closeness. Check every factual key against its own heard line. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
2026-10-09 photocopy follow-through: the original page is handed over physically with 拿给/交给, rather than sent as a digital file. Dialogue, reading, task answer and conversation acceptance remain aligned; saved IDs are preserved. Fresh audio and all gates required. Native review pending.
